title: Schedule of Return Premium Figures for Manufactured Home Insurance
content:
The figures that govern premium returned on an insured cancellation, and premium moved by a mid-term endorsement, on Manufactured Home Insurance:

| Policy form | Free-look period | Short-rate penalty | Minimum earned premium | Basis for mid-term premium changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | 10 calendar days | 10% of unearned premium | $100.00 | Pro rata |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | 10 calendar days | 10% of unearned premium | $100.00 | Pro rata |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | 10 calendar days | 10% of unearned premium | $100.00 | Pro rata |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | 10 calendar days | 10% of unearned premium | $100.00 | Pro rata |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | 10 calendar days | 10% of unearned premium | $100.00 | Pro rata |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | 10 calendar days | 10% of unearned premium | $100.00 | Pro rata |

## What each figure means

1. **Free-look period** — the calendar days after the effective date within which an insured cancellation receives a full refund of premium paid, the policy fee excepted.
2. **Short-rate penalty** — the percentage deducted from the pro-rata unearned premium when the insured cancels after the free-look period.
3. **Minimum earned premium** — the least premium retained on an insured cancellation after the free-look period.
4. **Basis for mid-term premium changes** — premium changes from a mid-term endorsement are computed pro rata.

## Illustrations (hypothetical amounts)

- A short-rate penalty of 10% on a hypothetical pro-rata unearned premium of $200.00 is $20.00.
- On a hypothetical annual premium of $250, the minimum earned premium of $100.00 means that at least $100.00 is retained on an insured cancellation after the free-look period.
